Our Referral Program

If you've enjoyed your Glass detail, why not share it with someone you care about?

Here's how it works:

  1. Tell a friend or family member about Glass Mobile Detailing.
  2. Once they book their detail, send us an email or text with their full name.
  3. We'll send you a $50 OFF discount code to use on your next service and we'll also apply the discount to your referral's booked appointment. (This is our biggest discount yet, so don't miss out!)

It's that simple — clean cars and savings all around! Together let's keep Arizona's cars CLEAN.
